# F09b

Synthetic statistics fixture; derived, unsigned, never a headline.

Construction: Minimum-V candidate in bounded seeded noisy two-cluster search. Seed: 2026101009.

Search 6000 trials, T=60, 48 low and 12 high draws. Each trial draws noise uniform(0.25,0.50), then low gauss(0,noise), high 3+gauss(0,noise). Set S=2*skew/(excess_kurtosis+2), retain 0.05<=S<=2, scale to sample sd=0.01 and mean=S*sd, round e8, and retain the smallest positive finite oracle V. Winner trial=1177, noise=0.25147475185985135, S=1.3014042622764388, V=0.06692170234846279. This is the minimum over these stated bounds, not a global minimum. No V clamp.

The stored e8 integers are authoritative. Design targets are construction goals, not expectations. Expectations come exclusively from the independent stdlib oracle using SPEC-03 E1–E15. The integers use round-to-nearest, ties-to-even.
